text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
*Yawn*... The weather is so nice today. So 
warm and cozy...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: P... Paka...

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text: ...-san! Kitasan Black-san!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ha!

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so this is where you were! Please get 
on standby!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Standby?

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
No, no, pull yourself together! We're 
right in the middle of a music festival!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: A music festival!?

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text: Come on, it's already your turn! Hurry up!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeees!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(I-I jumped out without thinking, but 
wh-wh-wh-what do I do now~!?)

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
Next up is our up-and-coming singer 
Umamusume! Kitasan Black!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Wh-What massive cheers! It's like a blast 
of hot air!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Besides, there are so many smiles... 
Everyone is looking at me with sparkling 
eyes.)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
“...... If that's the case, then what I... 
what I need to do is—”

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to sing! Please listen to... 
'Umapyoi Densetsu'!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ha!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
A dream... Haa, so it was just a dream~. 
Geez, you really scared me~.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan... Fufu, was it a nice dream? 
You've got a big smile on your face.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it was a really, really wonderful 
dream. There were so many smiling faces 
everywhere.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Besides, somehow... I can't put it into 
words well, but I feel like I've broken 
out of my shell!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From that day on, Kitasan Black's running 
seemed to take on an even sharper edge.
